Title: Amazon | SDE 2 | Loop | USA - Reject - Discuss - LeetCode

URL Source: https://leetcode.com/discuss/post/6467921/amazon-sde-2-loop-usa-reject-by-anonymou-ryqx/

Markdown Content:
I did an amazon full loop for SDE2 earlier in February 2025. Posting my results, excluding LP that was asked.

 I have just under 3 YOE in another MAG7 company

### Logical and Maintainable - Low level Design Interview

Designe a Grocery Cart Checkout

*   a food has a list of ingredients
*   the cart should check for ingredients that add extra taxes
*   the total should account for basic tax + ingredient taxes

**Result:**

*   i didnt finish because i was confused that this was an OOP interview, thought it mightve been leetcode style. but was 90% complete
*   The LP asked went very well

### System Design - High level design Interview - Bar raiser

Design Ad Click Aggregator

*   scale up to 10m clicks a minute
*   advertisers should be able to query their click data in real time < 2 minutes
*   customers should be redirected to ads with minimal latency < 200ms

**Result:**

*   I did great, best interview, struggled with one deep dive but did well in another
*   LP went amazing

### Data Structures and Algorithms Interview - Hiring Manager

[https://leetcode.com/problems/rotting-oranges/description/](https://leetcode.com/problems/rotting-oranges/description/)

slightly harder because

*   hexagon shapes instead of squares (6 directional)
*   it was a wildfire simulator instead with brushes spreading the fire
*   also there is directional windspeed that can make fire spread at a longer variable distance at 1 certain direction

**Result:**

*   1 LP went great, didnt seem completely satisfied with another LP
*   coding went great, interviewer seemed very happy

### Problem Solving Interview

[https://leetcode.com/problems/jump-game/description/](https://leetcode.com/problems/jump-game/description/)

and

[https://leetcode.com/problems/jump-game-ii/](https://leetcode.com/problems/jump-game-ii/)

*   except output jump path instead of total number of jumps

**Result**:

*   LP went great interviewer was very happy
*   finished first jump game - no problem
*   interviewer asked 3 non coding follow up questions on first jump game and was very happy with the questions
*   i wasnt able to finish 2nd jump game and struggled with it during the interview

### overall result

*   reject fell short just in coding.
*   because i did well in system design they would consider me for a technical program manager role if i was interested
*   they said because i did relatively well, my cooldown to reapply is 6 months instead of a year
